comparisons.peer_summary: On November 22, 2023, Broadcom completed the acquisition of VMware, Inc. in a cash-and-stock transaction valued at approximately $84,186 million ($30,788 million in cash and $53,398 million in stock), acquired to enhance infrastructure software capabilities, with results included commencing on the closing date.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom report on significant acquisitions completed or announced in the 2024 fiscal year using a mixed cash and stock consideration structure. AMD disclosed an agreement to acquire ZT Systems for approximately $4.9 billion, consisting of 8,335,852 shares and $3.4 billion in cash. Broadcom disclosed the completion of the VMware acquisition, where stockholders received approximately $30,788 million in cash and 544 million shares of Broadcom common stock with a fair value of $53,398 million. While Broadcom's VMware deal was completed in late 2023 (reported in 2024), and AMD's ZT Systems deal was announced in August 2024, both disclosures detail the specific mix of equity and cash used to finance large-scale strategic acquisitions.

sentences.text: On August 17, 2024, the Company entered into an agreement (the Agreement) to acquire ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems), a provider of AI and general purpose compute infrastructure for hyperscale computing companies, in a cash and stock transaction valued at approximately $4.9 billion (the Acquisition).
The aggregate closing consideration payable by the Company consists of 8,335,852 shares of the Company's common stock and $3.4 billion in cash.
On November 22, 2023, we completed the acquisition of VMware, Inc. ("VMware") in a cash-and-stock transaction (the "VMware Merger").
The VMware stockholders received approximately $30,788 million in cash and 544 million shares of Broadcom common stock (on a split adjusted basis) with a fair value of $53,398 million.
